name: HomeWizard P1 meter, local API
description: A dongle on the P1 port of a smart meter that answers on the participant's own network (API v1, enabled by the participant in the HomeWizard Energy app): the meter's offtake and injection registers by tariff, its power and voltage per phase, and the meters on its bus (gas, water). Read by @nexgen-os/homewizard; nothing leaves the place unless the installation stores it.
license: The data is the participant's, read on their own network
